purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/bernina-l-850.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Overview, stitch table, features; lists $3,999 MSRP, 'Buy Now' goes to Bernina USA shop, 'Find A Store' to dealer locator
Text layer; stitch table, technical specifications, standard accessories
Section 10.4 Specifications on p. 101; needle, stitch width, differential feed, thread cutter
Lists dust cover, power cable, foot control, knife cover insert, needle set, spool nets and discs, T10 screwdriver
General Bernina warranty page, not specific to the L 850
Comparison only; the /Serger/ URL for the L 890 returns 404, it sits under Overlock-Coverstitch-Combo

facts.value: 18 stitches

4-thread overlock 1; 3-thread: overlock wide/narrow, super-stretch, flatlock wide/narrow, narrow seam, rolled hem, picot (8 variations); 2-thread: overlock wide/narrow, flatlock wide/narrow, rolled hem, wrapped overlock wide/narrow, blanket stitch wide/narrow (9 variations)
facts.spec_value: 1 four-thread, 8 three-thread, 8 two-thread (overlock, flatlock, rolled hem)
facts.note: Total of 18 agrees. Our two-thread list omits wrapped overlock and blanket stitch (so 9, not 8), and our three-thread list omits narrow seam and picot. The 1/8/9 split is from the flyer's table; the page and the 'wide/narrow' counting differ, so count by named stitch. No coverstitch or chainstitch on this machine.

site.label: Stitch variations
site.juki: 18, with picot, narrow seam, wrapped overlock and blanket stitch in the list.
site.others: Dealer copy we used lists the 2-thread group as overlock, flatlock and rolled hem only.

facts.value: 2, 3 or 4 thread; 1 to 2 needles; 2 loopers
facts.note: Manual specification table lists the needle count as 1 to 2 (single-needle stitches use one needle).

facts.value: 1,500 stitches per minute maximum; 400 minimum

site.label: Speed
site.juki: Up to 1,500 stitches per minute (400 minimum).

facts.value: 5 5/8 in (143 mm) to the right of the needle; workspace height 3 3/8 in (86 mm)
facts.note: Bernina's own wording is 'space to the right of the needle', not throat or needle-to-arm. We treat it as the right-of-needle space; the page says it is more than any other Bernina serger. The L 860 and L 890 list the same 5 5/8 in; the L 460 lists 2 in.

site.label: Space right of needle
site.juki: 5 5/8 in (143 mm) to the right of the needle, 3 3/8 in (86 mm) workspace height.

facts.value: Adjustable while sewing; range 0.7 to 2 (manual); 'infinitely adjustable' (flyer)
facts.spec_value: Adjustable; ratio not published on pages found
facts.note: The ratio is published in the manual specification table (p. 101) and on p. 65 to 66: gather at 1.5 to 2, prevent puckering with 0.7 to 1.

facts.value: 0.8 to 4.5 mm, adjustable while sewing; fine adjustment 0.8 to 1.5 for rolled hem
Flyer: stitch width 3 to 9 mm. Manual: cutting width 5 to 9 mm for the left needle, 3 to 7 mm for the right needle
facts.note: The two figures are the same range seen two ways: the right needle is 2 mm narrower than the left.

facts.value: ELx705 CF, sizes 70 to 90 (10 to 14); 130/705 H needles can also be used 'if required'
facts.note: Maker manual p. 48 allows 130/705 H needles. Standard accessories: set of ELx705 CF (3 x size 80, 2 x size 90).

facts.value: DC motor; energy consumption 140 W; input 100 to 240 V (50 to 60 Hz)
facts.note: 140 W is Bernina's 'energy consumption' figure, not a rated motor output.

facts.value: 27.1 lb (12.3 kg); boxed about 37.5 lb (17 kg)
43 x 28 x 35 cm (16.9 x 11.0 x 13.8 in) without thread stand; 57 x 35 x 35 cm (22.4 x 13.8 x 13.8 in) with slide-on table and cut-offs bin
facts.note: Our figure came from a dealer listing and does not match Bernina's manual in any dimension. Bernina's figures replace it.

site.label: Dimensions
site.juki: 43 x 28 x 35 cm (16.9 x 11.0 x 13.8 in) without thread stand.
site.others: A dealer listing gave 18 x 13 x 16 in.

facts.value: 2-step lifter with front-foot lift (front foot lifts a further 3 to 4 mm); knee lifter (Free Hand System); swing-out foot with auto swing back; 6-step presser foot pressure
facts.spec_value: 2-step presser foot lifter with front-foot lift; swing-out foot; knee lifter; 6-step pressure
facts.note: No total lift height in mm is published; only the 3 to 4 mm extra step.

facts.value: 'Thread cutter' on the outside of the machine for cutting the thread chain by hand (manual p. 40); no automatic trimmer listed
facts.note: Maker lists a thread cutter as a comfort feature; it is a manual chain cutter, not an automatic thread trimmer.

facts.value: One-step Air Threader for both loopers via foot control; built-in needle threader; color-coded one-path threading; automatic needle stop up
facts.spec_value: One-Step Air Threader for both loopers via foot control; built-in needle threader

facts.value: Freearm; slide-on extension table

Flyer: standard overlock foot #L10 with tape guide, slide-on extension table, accessories box, cut-offs bin, right seam guide, tweezers, manual needle threader, ELX705 CF needle set, brush, screwdriver, dust cover. Accessories page: dust cover, power cable, foot control, knife cover insert, needle set, spool nets and discs, T10 screwdriver
facts.spec_value: Standard overlock foot; extension table included; accessory box extension optional on L 850
facts.note: Page versus flyer: the accessories page does not list the overlock foot, extension table or accessories box that the flyer and main page list. The L 460 page sells an 'Extension Box' for the L 8 series separately, so an optional extension box is plausible, but no L 850 document says so directly.

facts.value: Bernina International AG limited warranty: 2 years electrical parts, 5 years printed circuit boards, 20 years mechanical parts, from date of purchase. Covers parts only; labor and shipping not covered. Original purchaser only, not transferable. Private, non-commercial use. Registration (or dealer-countersigned card) within 30 days
facts.spec_value: Bernina US: 20 yr mechanical parts, 5 yr printed circuit boards, 2 yr electrical parts; labor not covered
facts.note: General Bernina warranty page; it does not name the L 850 and is not model-specific.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 2 years electrical, 5 years circuit boards, 20 years mechanical parts; parts only, no labor.
site.others: A dealer page adds a 1 year service warranty, which is the dealer's own.

facts.value: $3,999.00 Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (page, 2026-10-02)
facts.note: Dealer pricing only otherwise; Bernina sets MSRP and dealers set what they charge.

facts.value: Page shows a Buy Now link to Bernina USA's shop and a Find A Store link. No wording on the page saying the L 850 is discontinued or no longer available.

site.label: Where to buy
site.juki: Bernina sells through dealers; the page links to a store locator.
site.others: No Amazon or marketplace listing for the machine itself was found.

facts.value: L 460: 16 stitches, 1,500 spm, 2 in right of needle, manual needle threader, $1,999 MSRP. L 860: 18 stitches, 4.3 in touch screen, guided mode, 28.9 lb, $4,999 MSRP. L 890: 27 stitches (overlock/coverstitch combo), 1,350 spm, 29.5 lb, $8,749 MSRP
facts.note: Spec text says the L 860 costs about $1,500 more per an owner; Bernina's MSRPs differ by $1,000 ($3,999 vs $4,999). Sources: L 460, L 860 and L 890 pages (ids l460, l860, l890).

facts.value: "The ultimate Overlocker" (page subhead; also a testimonial quote by textile designer Andrea Muller); "A true masterpiece among sergers"; 'extremely fast, precise and quiet'; 'Designed and engineered in Switzerland'; 'more room to the right of the needle and more work space height than any other BERNINA serger'
facts.note: Marketing wording, listed as claims only. 'Extremely quiet' has no decibel figure in any document.

facts.value: No decibel figure; no total presser foot lift height; no motor wattage rating (only 140 W energy consumption); no frame material
facts.note: Left as [verify] where our spec is null.
